papers.title: Chronicle: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Joint Language and Time Series Understanding
papers.what: First model jointly pretrained from scratch on text and time series; 324M params, SOTA on UCR/UEA classification and Time-MMD fusion.

papers.title: Olivia: Harmonizing Time Series Foundation Models with Power Spectral Density
papers.what: ICML 2026. Spectral harmonization via PSD reshaping for TS foundation model pretraining; SOTA on TSLib and GIFT-Eval.

papers.title: Compact Latent Manifold Translation for Cross-Modal Physiological Signal Synthesis
papers.what: Tiny 0.09B model translates between ECG, PPG, EEG modalities and frequencies using hierarchical residual VQ.

papers.title: Human-Inspired Memory Architecture for LLM Agents
papers.what: Bio-grounded agent memory with sleep consolidation, forgetting, reconsolidation — six cognitive mechanisms as concrete modules.
